snapshotIdentity: Base commit plus exact current hashes; uncommitted audit sources are listed separately

history.boundary: Historical owner delivery only; not current branch/signature/matrix acceptance

share.stop: Owned atomic batches copy files during provider callbacks and feed Host ingress review. Installed target/action selection, INT-02 dispatch, expiry and execution receipt readback remain unconnected; historical share-inbox.json is retained.

translation.stop: Declarative snapshot/action continuation is not an NS/Expo runtime route. Resume requires an appIntent entrypoint; Expo non-widget exposure is rejected.

widget.stop: Existing Expo/ScriptWidget callbacks commit revision/nonces in the widget-specific runtime. They do not expose the five canonical Host runtimes or an NS foreground VM.

notification.stop: Media attachment/category delivery only; no authenticated package event envelope, Host consumer or MiniApp receipt.

liveActivity.stop: Static ActivityKit presentation is not a canonical Node/TS/Python/JSC/Shell execution path.

hostAppIntent.stop: NS declared action can dispatch through the existing broker and persist its action value/status in a protected durable receipt. Busy NS session yields needsForeground; Expo yields an explicit unsupported receipt. Native queue/executor cases and real compiled-intent result passed; actual NS/Expo system ingress readback, full context and attachment acceptance remain open.

shortcuts.stop: Generic MiniApp action enqueues foreground continuation. Registered Siri phrases are alarm/notification operations; not an all-runtime MiniApp API.

foreground.stop: NS generic async facade and Expo use the same canonical JSON/full-receipt route. NS captures its bound bridge, with session-owned cancel handles and teardown cancellation. Actual VM/metadata/backend tests are pending; legacy NS strings keep their historical result boundary.
